author: Ayeda Okambawa
name: EnfuseSimple
description: Blends a series of differently-focused or differently-exposed shots into a single focus-stacked or HDR image using enfuse.
description-extensive: Blends several photos of the same scene — taken at different focus points or exposures — into one combined image, giving you front-to-back sharpness or a balanced high-dynamic-range result. It requires the free enfuse and align_image_stack tools (part of the Hugin package) to be installed.
